objective: Execute an already-planned correlated Telnyx canonical-attempt reconciliation against River CRM D1 while preserving provider-event receipt idempotency and optimistic stale-attempt semantics.
identityRules: canonical attempt provider must remain telnyx
canonical attempt providerReference is not required to equal a lead-leg call_control_id
executionRules: no-op plans record the provider-event receipt without updating the attempt
update plans compare-and-swap the canonical attempt before recording the receipt
a zero-row compare-and-swap returns retryable stale-attempt and does not consume the receipt
a successful compare-and-swap followed by duplicate receipt insertion remains successful and duplicate
provider-event receipt insertion failure after successful compare-and-swap is surfaced so provider redelivery remains recoverable
changed-row counts other than zero or one are rejected
compatibility: This executor is a single execution primitive; reread and replan retry belongs to a later correlated application slice.
next: INS-002E2C3D3 may compose correlation resolution, correlated attempt planning, bounded stale recovery, durable bridge application, and receipt-safe attempt execution.
